t0022-01.gloss: A collection record places a route closure before the return of its equipment.
t0022-01.rival_reading: A test crew could have recorded a temporary site closure before retrieving equipment; the blank line does not say who set the schedule.

t0022-02.gloss: A field-trial warning and a household access problem remain on the same note.
t0022-02.rival_reading: A response crew could have sealed ordinary pest-control supplies while closing an area; keeping the jars shut does not show the trial malfunctioned.
